transform.name: five-position permutation
transform.leading_zero_policy: Preserve five-position strings exactly. A zero-padded normalization is derived data and must not replace an exact shorter seed.

active_unexpanded_seed_note.rule: Do not silently conflate with 09675. Any five-position normalization must be separately recorded.

evidence_classes.P2: Physical relational closure: two or more generated states occur in the same physical system with a documented physical relationship.
evidence_classes.P1: Physical-value hit: generated state matches or nearly matches a measured/derived physical quantity with units and provenance.
evidence_classes.G1: Mathematical graph closure among generated states; no physical causality implied.
evidence_classes.M1: Technical metadata collision: identifier, DOI/arXiv/CVE/article/accession number, etc.
evidence_classes.N0: Incidental collision/control: registry, report, page, product, ordinary ID, or unrelated number.

verification_statuses.verified_primary: Verified in an original/primary technical publication or official authoritative data source.
verification_statuses.verified_current_authority: Verified in a current authoritative compilation or government database.
verification_statuses.historical_primary_reconcile_current: Verified in historical primary literature; current compilation reconciliation still required.
verification_statuses.carry_forward_unverified: Previously reported in this inquiry but not reverified in the present ingestion pass.
verification_statuses.negative_control: Intentionally retained as a collision/control exemplar.

evidence_records.physical_context: W II classified spectral line; transition 23046_(3.5) -> 54026_(2.5) odd.
evidence_records.claims_boundary: Near-match in a dense spectral table; not evidence that the digit permutation generated the spectrum.

evidence_records.physical_context: W II line from lower level a^4P_(3/2) at 10592.52 cm^-1 to upper level 50292.33 cm^-1.
evidence_records.claims_boundary: Relational candidate because it shares the same lower level with EV-WII-41494-48; statistical significance unresolved.

evidence_records.physical_context: W II classified line sharing lower level a^4P_(3/2) with the 39699.84 cm^-1 line; upper level approximately 52087 cm^-1.
evidence_records.claims_boundary: Relational candidate only; topology-preserving null test required.
Documented separation between two independently seeded near-matches; no causal interpretation.
Excellent numerical near-match; still subject to multiple-testing and line-density controls.

evidence_records.physical_context: Yb II level listed by NIST; persistent 2224.46 Å transition from the ground level reaches 44940.61 cm^-1.
evidence_records.claims_boundary: Near-match; treat only as reference/validation target.

evidence_records.physical_context: Historical Yb II paper contains a level labeled 56977; current NIST handbook excerpt does not list an exact 56977 level.
evidence_records.claims_boundary: Retain as historical evidence and reconciliation task; do not state as current NIST-confirmed level.

evidence_records.physical_context: Reported improved H-SH bond dissociation energy D0(H-SH)=31449(2) cm^-1.
evidence_records.claims_boundary: Exact central-value match; multiple-testing correction still mandatory.

evidence_records.physical_context: 09379 is part of arXiv identifier 2208.09379, not a physical measurement.
evidence_records.claims_boundary: Zero evidence weight for the number hypothesis. Publication remains useful for non-destructive quantum-device/material characterization.

evidence_records.action: If iccDEV is introduced anywhere in the image/ICC analysis stack, require >=2.3.1.5; otherwise record dependency as absent/not detected.
evidence_records.claims_boundary: Security identifier collision only; no physics evidence.
Same digit sequence as a historical spectroscopy candidate but here it is only a CAS Registry prefix. Deliberately retained as a discriminative paired control.
Article number collision; methodology may inform video-analysis pipelines, but identifier gives no support to the number hypothesis.
Exact deterministic graph closure. Prior random-set sanity check indicated additive closures of this kind are not by themselves statistically anomalous.

wii_dataset.interpretation: Raw W II near-hit count is not anomalous under this crude uniform-density baseline. The same-lower-level topology of 39699.84 and 41494.48 is the higher-value feature to test next.
wii_dataset.next_test: Topology-preserving null: sample/randomize target sets against the W II transition graph while preserving target count/range, then compare frequency of shared lower/upper-level closures.

operational_rules: Every discovered publication or information item must have at least one Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
No metadata collision is allowed to contribute physical-evidence weight.
Exact and near matches must retain units, delta, source authority, seed/window provenance, and multiple-testing context.
Counterevidence and failed searches are first-class evidence records.
Promotion from P1/P2 candidate to a substantive scientific claim requires null-model testing and independent replication/validation.
Source discovery does not imply causal connection to the number transform.
